page.content:
Grail knight of perfect chastity, son of Lancelot.

How Galahad connects

  • Item: Siege Perilous — Galahad alone may sit in the Siege Perilous.
  • Event: Grail Quest — Galahad is the knight who achieves the Grail.
  • Character: Lancelot — Lancelot is father of Galahad.
  • Faction: Round Table — Galahad takes the Siege Perilous at the Table.

What is Galahad?

Galahad sits in the Siege Perilous, achieves the Holy Grail at Corbenic, and is taken from the world. He completes what Lancelot's love makes impossible.

Key threads lead to Siege Perilous, Grail Quest, Lancelot and Round Table.
